dedupe_keys.name: gui global urban infrastructure geometry and city statistics

description: GUI describes urban infrastructure through city tables, category counts and mapped entity boundaries. Tsinghua University FIB Lab publishes the archive to support geospatial analysis using visual foundation models. City attributes include identifiers, names, population, administrative status, country economic context and polygon geometry. Infrastructure tables link city codes to main categories, subcategories, entity counts and individual geometries. Coverage is described as global, but the README does not state the number of cities, collection dates or image resolution. Geometry uses EPSG:4326; city area is calculated in EPSG:6933. A public compressed archive contains CSV, GeoJSON and Parquet representations and the repository reports an MIT licence. Access is free. A limitation is that detected entities are model-derived, not a verified engineering asset register, and the linked paper citation is incomplete. The city population and country-level GDP fields also have different units of analysis. Simulation uses include constructing initial infrastructure exposure layers and comparing urban asset distributions. It complements data-openstreetmap, but no equivalence between their classifications is established. The archive was listed, not downloaded, and extraction accuracy was not tested.
name: GUI global urban infrastructure geometry and city statistics
notes: G8; G8-0178. Metadata and documentation checked. Data payloads and software execution were not tested. Simulation uses are curator interpretations.
